subject.title: fix(gateway): hide stream-error sentinel from chat history

question: Should gateway chat-history display suppress a provenanced stream-error sentinel row when later assistant content exists in the same user turn?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow, but it intentionally changes what chat.history and live session-history SSE deliver to clients in a repaired-turn case, so a maintainer should accept the visible-history contract before merge.

options.title: Accept Display-Only Suppression
options.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping persisted transcript rows unchanged while hiding the repaired sentinel from full history and live SSE display.

options.title: Require A Stricter Guard
options.body: Ask for an additional guard or test documenting exactly when the sentinel must remain visible before merge.

options.title: Pause For Product Review
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked if the team is not ready to decide repaired-turn display semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept Display-Only Suppression
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review, keeping persisted transcript rows unchanged while hiding the repaired sentinel from full history and live SSE display.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned on the PR and is the strongest adjacent owner from the failed-turn display baseline history.
